name: Jamshri Realty Limited
about: Jamshri Realty Limited develops and leases real estate properties in India. It operates through two segments, Property and Related Services, and Hospitality Services. The company is also involved in the hospitality business. In addition, it operates business parks, restaurants, residences, resort and banquets, and lawns. The company was formerly known as The Jamshri Ranjitsinghji Spinning and Weaving Mills Company Limited and changed its name to Jamshri Realty Limited in December 2019. Jamshri Realty Limited was incorporated in 1907 and is based in Mumbai, India.
